verdict.rationale: YPOG is a law and tax advisory firm (transactions, funds, notary services, ESOP advice), not a software tool or agent that could act as an MCP client, so plugging in MCP servers is a category error. Its mentions of internal legal tech and the software-supported YSolutions service describe how it delivers advice, not a user-facing product that consumes MCP tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
